Name: Giant Qi Plush
Author: Waxhell
Description:
Use Qi Fruit to make a Giant Qi Plush!   It only takes 25 Qi Fruit, 20 Fiber, and 2 Ancient Seed (Artifact) to craft a Giant Qi Plush!

As a side-effect, using a Deconstructor on your poor plush yields back the Qi Fruit.

(Yes.... the point of this mod was to outsmart Mr. Qi in the new Stardew Valley 1.6!)

This mod requires Content Patcher and Craft Anything Framework!
